linkedin-square.composition: Square editorial visual, one semantic focus and generous margins.

youtube-thumbnail.composition: Wide thumbnail with one large focal relationship and minimal text.

shorts.composition: Vertical three-phase storyboard; preserve breathing room at top and bottom.

website-hero.composition: Wide conceptual hero with negative space for independently typeset copy.

infographic.composition: Portrait evidence-linked infographic, use short labels and explicit alternatives.

scenario-triptych.composition: Three equal INPUT, EVENT, OUTCOME panels. Alternatives remain separate, not consecutive events.

capability-cover.composition: Cover concept representing this scenario within its named capability; do not imply full capability coverage.
